_source: Synthetic representative samples — v1 dev_cheap runs flagged 10/30 cases as is_error but did not persist raw_response (instrumentation gap). These patterns cover the canonical LLM-JSON failure modes that the haiku-4-5-routed Hypothesis agent has emitted on inspection of past stderr traces and OpenRouter dashboards.
_failure_modes: fence_only_unfenced — single line of bare JSON wrapped in fence
prose_preamble_then_json — explainer text before the object
trailing_prose_after_json — fence then commentary then more fence
code_fence_no_lang_then_trailing — ``` then object then ``` then text
